label: caiso 70 g61b decrowd
definition: (PROBE — pre-registered A/B, negative result) G-61b de-crowding main -- caiso-69 recipe (SP15-split topology, ct_netload_drag=False per-run override) + caiso_ra_bridge_startup_aware=True single delta, 2023-2025. HYPOTHESIS (from caiso-69's corrected redirect): the RA must-offer bridge's forced CC min-gen crowds CT_PEAKER out of the pockets — releasing the phantom-micro-run share should let pocket CTs clear on merit. The de-crowding hypothesis is REFUTED: bridge headroom is not what keeps peakers out. C7 CT shape still FAILs (profile_r 0.76/0.76/0.68 — the retired drag was carrying CT's diurnal shape). C8 PASS (bridge remnant 3.7/3.1/2.4% of CC). FIRST CAISO RUN WITH C6 GOVERNANCE PASS: bundle carries the rubric governance attestation + the caiso-65 DOF ledger (drag entry marked INERT; startup-aware adds zero free parameters). Scored under rubric v2.4 (caiso-69 scored under v2.2 — C5a CO2 is FAIL here where v2.2 gave commercial-band CAVEAT; cross-version comparisons should re-score, not read stored statuses).
